body: Stephen A. Smith has stated that Dan Quinn's tenure with the Washington Commanders is over, a sentiment echoed by multiple outlets on October 22, 2026. While Quinn has reportedly hired a former head coach amid an uncertain future, Smith's comments suggest his time in Washington has concluded.

findings.evidence_quote: Stephen A. Smith Says Dan Quinn's Time in Washington Is Over as the Commanders Hit Their Bye
